profile.name: Mediana
profile.title: The Dangerous Doctor Mediana
profile.story: A practitioner of the medical arts developed when priests were short in supply. She inherited her natural medical talent from her father, but her thirst for knowledge crossed the line when she began researching poison. As a result, she was excommunicated from medical society, but her enthusiasm for research was seemingly unaffected. However, her basic respect for life kept her from achieving any experimental results for her poison research. When the Demons appeared, she became overjoyed at finding rare and precious test subjects.

uw.story:
The story goes back to when Mediana's poison experiments were still being kept secret from her peers. One day, a fellow doctor noticed the giant syringe she had made. Impressed by its sheer size, he asked her:
'Look at the size of that thing. Shouldn't you at least give it a name?'
To this, Mediana replied, nonchalantly:
'Oh... Just call it... Piston.'

A collection of Mediana's special healthy injections. These liquids are all made up of unknown substances and have a mystical glimmer.
These were made with folk remedies that Mediana learned from every corner of the continent. Mediana insists that they provide recovery, but their abuse can lead to some extreme results.

2.name: Special Potion of Double Reaction
2.description: [Special Water Cannon] Increases Resistance by 30% and reduces Cooldown by {0}%.
2.story:
A special potion that has two type of effects.
Mediana wondered if there was a way to handle attack and recovery at once. She went to the library and read a dusty book called 'Slimes Can Also Make Cannons.' 
Mediana was reading just for fun, but found a way to apply the principle of cannons into her piston. She was then able to invent the Special Potion of Double Reaction and maximize recovery and attack when using Special Water Cannon. Mediana is still thankful to the author of the book who gave her the inspiration.

4.story:
A strange medical test report that Doctor Aldini gave to his student, Mediana.
For a long time, he had kept notes about the autopsies he performed, and handed the records to Mediana, hoping that the traditional art of medicine would live on in her hands.
Filled with joy, she has read it numerous times, and it was this report that made Mediana's Special Poison possible.

sw.story:
Phistonia, Mediana’s unique gigantic syringe, has contained many different samples and antibodies from the past experiments.
Because Phistonia had once contained the blood of Demons, Dragons, and even demonic beasts, the remains of that power from those fluids started forming a maelstrom of power within Phistonia. It got to the point where even Mediana, who had limited knowledge on otherworldly power, could feel that there’s something wrong.
The disease needed to be treated. Hence, Mediana decided to ‘treat’ this ‘disease’ before Phistonia turns into something not suited for medical use.
Mediana was swift and precise, living up to her title of a genius.
She extracted samples from a Draconic, XXX, and even from XX, which she went through so much trouble gathering...
And when she finally combined these samples from things that cannot be named to make an antibody, it started to shine brightly.

Mediana pushed the antibody into Phistonia, and at that moment,
a vortex of power exploded. The mixture inside Phistonia went through evaporation, and an energy in the purest form was born.
A soul to succeed Mediana’s will to experiment and research, had awakened.
